hello_outro: Run bytebureau --help to see what is available.
cli_unknown_locale: Unsupported language "{locale}", falling back to English.
run_ask_waiting: The employee is waiting for your answer to "{title}" (not answered automatically)
run_event_skipped: Skipped the {type} event (seq {seq}): its payload does not fit its type
run_completed: Done — turns: {turns}, input tokens: {input}, output tokens: {output}{cost}
ask_needs_answer: Ask {id} needs --option or --other outside a terminal
ask_no_recommended: Ask {id} has no recommended option; pass --option or --other
profiles_wait_login: Press Enter once you have logged in
profiles_default_set: Profile {id} is now the default of its provider
profiles_key_missing: --api-key needs a key: type it at the prompt or pipe it on stdin
profiles_key_argument: The API key is never an argument: pass --api-key alone and type it at the prompt, or pipe it on stdin
status_sessions: Sessions: {running} running, {waiting} waiting for you, {total} in all
serve_still_running: Daemon (pid {pid}) did not stop in time
serve_timeout: The daemon did not come up in time; see {log}
serve_lan_warning: Listening on {host}: anyone on the network with the token can use this daemon
bureau_daemon_running: A daemon is running on {url} (pid {pid}); drop --no-daemon or stop it with bytebureau serve --stop
bureau_token_hint: {detail} (pass the token of that daemon with --token-file)
serve_failed: The daemon failed to start; see {log}
serve_lock_stuck: The lock {lock} names pid {pid}, which does not answer as a daemon of this home; if none is running, clear the lock with bytebureau serve --stop
serve_lock_cleared: Cleared the stale lock of pid {pid}, which is not a daemon of this home
serve_lock_silent: A daemon of this home (pid {pid}) holds the lock but does not answer; it may be stopped or busy, and if it is not a daemon of this home, delete {lock}
